historical_knowledge_policy: These are retrospective development data. Hiding labels does not remove pretrained historical knowledge. Do not claim prospective forecasting skill; preserve future timestamped forecasts as a separate benchmark. No SFT targets are created from realized outcomes.
rationale: Reviewed the 250 native-market question titles and 250 expanded-series templates in the frozen 2244-entry ForecastBench index. The selected 2024/2025 monthly FOMC decisions are not the same outcomes as recession, Fed-chair nominations, securities prices or later series-change questions. Common macroeconomic drivers are acknowledged, not treated as equivalent labels. All unselected PMA parents are excluded, including annual rate-cut totals, cumulative deadlines, cross-meeting paths, dissent combos and mention markets. This is a cohort-specific source review, never automatic semantic clearance from a lexical non-match.
reviewed_by: Codex source/scope review; not an independent human certification
